recognize_zh: 淋巴結被成片、單一形態的小至中型淋巴球瀰漫取代，核圓、染色質顆粒狀，部分細胞可見小核仁（前淋巴球），細胞質少，濾泡結構消失；這種單調圓核淋巴球浸潤是 CLL/SLL 的表現，需 CD5/CD23/LEF1 等免疫染色確認。
features: Diffuse effacement of nodal architecture by a monotonous lymphoid infiltrate
Small-to-intermediate cells with round, regular nuclei and granular chromatin
Scattered cells with slightly larger nuclei, more open chromatin and small central nucleoli (prolymphocytes/paraimmunoblasts)
Scant pale cytoplasm; occasional mitotic figures
Thin-walled vessels traversing the infiltrate; no follicles or starry-sky pattern
describe_en: Section of lymph node shows diffuse effacement of architecture by a monotonous population of small-to-intermediate lymphoid cells with round, regular nuclei, granular chromatin and scant pale cytoplasm. Scattered slightly larger cells with more open chromatin and small central nucleoli, consistent with prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts, are interspersed, and occasional mitoses are seen. No residual follicles, starry-sky pattern or necrosis are present in this field. Findings are consistent with involvement by small lymphocytic lymphoma/chronic lymphocytic leukemia; immunohistochemistry (CD5, CD23, LEF1, cyclin D1) is recommended, and if the larger cells form confluent sheets, expanded proliferation centers or large-cell transformation should be considered.

ddx.vs: MCL cells have irregular, slightly angulated nuclei without paraimmunoblasts or proliferation centers, often with pink histiocytes and hyalinized vessels, and are cyclin D1/SOX11-positive and CD23-negative.
MZL cells have more abundant pale (monocytoid) cytoplasm, colonize follicles and are CD5- and CD23-negative.
LPL shows plasmacytoid differentiation with Dutcher bodies and clonal plasma cells and lacks CD5/CD23 coexpression.
Richter shows confluent sheets of large cells with nuclei larger than histiocyte nuclei and high Ki-67, rather than scattered paraimmunoblasts in a small-cell background.
